# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Architecture
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Database migration
- [ ] Test
- [ ] Refactor

## Related documents

List the relevant handbook, decision, business-rule, API, or module documents.

## Scope control

- [ ] The change stays within the stated scope.
- [ ] No unrelated module changes were made.
- [ ] No architecture decisions were changed without documentation.

## Tests

Describe tests run or explain why tests are not applicable.

## Business impact

Describe operational impact, if any.

## Rollback

Describe rollback or recovery steps, if applicable.

## Reviewer notes

Call out anything requiring special attention.
